crossRefs.note: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live…
So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

people.name: Aram
people.line: Son of Shem, ancestor of the Arameans

people.name: Geshur
people.line: Aramean kingdom; Talmai's domain; refuge for Absalom

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.

people.name: Havvoth-jair
people.line: Villages in Gilead captured by Jair

people.name: Kenath
people.line: A city in Gilead, captured by Nobah and renamed

people.name: Machir
people.line: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead

translations.web: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
translations.bsb: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
translations.kjv: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
translations.asv: And Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and the villages thereof, even threescore cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
